summary.text: Jamie Pedersen is a Democratic member of the Washington State Senate from District 43, which he has represented since 2013, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against fellow Democrat Hannah Sabio-Howell.
A lawyer, he was elected Senate majority leader in November 2024.

paragraphs.text: Pedersen was born in Puyallup, Washington, and graduated from Puyallup High School.
He received a bachelor's degree from Yale College in 1990 and a J.D. from Yale Law School in 1994, then clerked for Judge Stephen Williams on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the D.C. Circuit.
He was a lawyer at K&L Gates from 1995 to 2012, then joined McKinstry, where he was executive vice president and general counsel as of 2026.
Pedersen represented House District 43 from 2007 to 2013, and the King County Council appointed him to a vacant Senate seat in 2013.
He chaired the Senate Law & Justice Committee, served as majority floor leader from 2022 to 2024, and was elected majority leader in November 2024.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Pedersen said his campaign messages include a fully funded education system from early learning through higher education, changes to the state tax structure for working families, and increasing the supply of all types of housing.
